summary.description: one or two sentences: what the requester actually wants

text_says.description: what the description or attachment states instead

same.description: true if the two actually agree

mismatches.description: facts the description or an attachment states differently from the form (type, value, date, party). Usually empty.

bespoke_asks.description: asks the standard template will not cover, e.g. counterparty paper, custom terms

negotiation_points.description: terms the requester or an attachment signals will be negotiated
